faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master of Science (M.Sc.) degree in Agricultural Meteorology to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per university rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University located?
faq.answer: Chaudhary Charan Singh Haryana Agricultural University is located in Hisar, Haryana, with the pincode 125004.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position?
faq.answer: The Young Professional-II (YP-II) position is a contractual job, offering a fixed tenure employment opportunity.
